name: DAAWBench
description: DAAWBench is a large-scale Depth-Aware Air-Writing dataset for recognizing in-air handwriting gestures, featuring 8.8 million RGB-D frames annotated with 3,755 Chinese characters. It challenges the traditional 2D single-stroke assumption by incorporating depth cues to improve stroke segmentation and character recognition.
reputation: A recent large-scale benchmark that is useful for depth-aware air-writing research, but it is not yet as widely established as long-running vision benchmarks.
notes: First large-scale depth-aware air-writing dataset; shows depth modeling significantly improves recognition accuracy over 2D-only methods.
